Naviamp v2.11.0

Naviamp 2.11.0 expands Aurral support into a complete discovery and request hub, alongside your music library and playback queue.

- Explore full Recommendations and catalog Search pages, related artists, releases and editions, track previews and Trending charts.
- Follow requests through waiting for release, acquisition and validated Library availability, including after reconnecting.
- Block genres and use supported Radio methods and more varied Library mixes, with artist-diversity limits.
- Choose new artwork layouts and clearer repeat controls, with playback, radio, TV, lyrics and translation improvements across the app.

Connect Naviamp directly to your compatible Aurral server. Features follow server capabilities and account permissions; newer discovery and chart actions need a compatible API. Aurral manages acquisition and release scheduling. Acquisition cancel/retry remains available through Aurral itself.

GitHub downloads contain v2.11.0. Store and TestFlight channels update separately. The official signed Linux Flatpak currently contains v2.10.0 while its update awaits signing; direct Linux downloads contain v2.11.0.

The database upgrades automatically to retain request history. Update other devices to v2.11.0 before syncing the new artwork and TV settings. Original album Play-button Gapless and TV queue-end Autoplay reports remain under investigation; Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta.

Thanks

- Welcome first-time contributor @crsthn-slv for radio, TV, playback and lyrics improvements, testing, and the Brazilian Portuguese translation.
- Welcome first-time contributor @sewnie for reporting the Android startup failure when the Cast module is unavailable.
